responsibility: Provides the narrow 64-bit PowerPC Darwin override layer on top of the generic rs6000 Darwin configuration. Its job is to make Darwin default to the ppc64 subarchitecture by selecting 64-bit target masks and by redefining the Darwin arch/subarch and CRT2 spec fragments, so the driver, preprocessor specs, and startup-file selection for Mac OS X use the 64-bit PowerPC ABI without reimplementing the broader Mach-O/Darwin target logic in darwin.h.
